summary: Draft SCF-only plan for NiO using collinear PBE+U and the supplied site-ordered moments.
notes: Preserved all four sites in Ni, O, Ni, O order; moments are initial seeds in mu_B.
Dudarev +U uses the supplied Ni U and J, giving U_eff = 4.5 eV; oxygen +U is excluded.
Used supplied defaults ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05 eV and NELM=120. SAXIS=[0,0,1] follows the collinear, no-SOC convention.
No SOC, hybrid, relaxation or settings copied from past runs.
MAGMOM seeds do not establish a magnetic ground state: https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/MAGMOM
Requested cutoff and mesh are preserved; convergence remains unverified: https://www.vasp.at/wiki/index.php/ENCUT
